official_sources.claim: Running model digest and residency fields

behavior: Expected digest/name/quantization loaded from provisioned model manifest.
Before stream, warm digest is checked against ps; cold digest is checked against tags after ps shows no resident target.
Missing/unknown/different digest refuses before api/chat and before context transmission.
Warm admission also refuses wrong digest; generation metrics carry verified digest and manifest hash.
limits: Explicit MockTransport and controlled manifest fixture; no real server or model called.
Verification is immediately before api/chat; model tag changes by an external writer are outside the supervisor-controlled qualification.
No modifications to main.py after memory-ready snapshot.
